name: Cam-unfolding link: a cam-slaved knee K = c(q2) in link 2 (pin-knee closure, sensor-free)
lens: overhead-first; round 6 lens 1 (sensor-free knuckle), arm-side variant
family: redundant 4R with a cam-slaved 4th joint (3 active)

mechanism.notes: the pin knee (rows/skin-normal-3r-pin-knee.json mechanism) + K: link 2 split into 2a / 2b by an O20 passive bearing-pair pin, NOT sensed (K = c(q2) is read from q2), slaved by a groove face cam on link 1 at J2 (best build: a 3 mm grooved ring on hub 2's crown) (O3 iglidur-sleeved follower pin on a lever of 2a = 1 sliding pair) through an O2 pushrod (2 pins) to a 4 mm crank on 2b: +2 bodies (2b, pushrod), +3 joints, 1 closed loop; complexity 33.75 (tools/simplicity.py; the pin knee 19.5)

verdict: Screened (gate passed: 9339 CMA tries, +0.52 / +0.21 score points over the 2nd half / last third, top-5 within 0.10). Best = C3, the CROWN cam (hub 2 stays O20, 15.25 tall) with a TWO-SIDED lobe: 22.02 plain / 23.23 near-touch fast; frozen on Bench(110,360) exact 26.70 (score 90.29), near-touch 28.40, reach 0.656, in-band 0.889, contact 0.012, overhead reach 8/28. The cam is worth 8.8 points over the plain pin knee at the same seats (30.85) and ties the verified pin knee H1 (27.20 same protocol; near-touch 31.75) at +14.25 complexity; 7.6 behind the verified minarc BDp (19.06). Sensor-free 3 active, 0 passive translations. Not a new leader; self-measured, unverified.
limiter: The fold still takes 115 of the big bench's lost poses: the cam window is only th 34.5-97.9 because K can unfold a2 by just 4.8 deg (a2e 63.8-68.6) where its hub stays in band. Hub K rides on link 2 (moves with q1 AND q2): a GH-ray O20 disc there is in band only within ~21-30 deg of J2 (K-atlas: elsewhere the 5-95 % skin-height spread under it is 19-35 mm vs the 12 mm band); toward J1 it clashes with hub 1 over the q2 window, along link 2's line it is nearly straight (no leverage). The O30 flange cam made it worse (hub K 0.42 in band); the crown cam lets K sit at 21 deg (0.77). L2a is 0.17 in band (a 25 mm stub between two hubs).
note: Coarse farm sweep 256 (best 40.91 near), K-atlas + targeted sweep 192 (59.47), CMA S1-S6 flange cam 5206 tries (27.07 near / 25.85 plain; frozen 31.88), S2 continuation 1354 (26.55), crown-cam CMA C1-C3 2779 (23.23). Controls at the best seats: cam off 30.81, no K 30.85 (plain). Red team: no jam (one q2 per pose), J2 dowel stop felt at th 97.9; pinch 0.83 mm frozen at plane 30 / elev 165 (hub 2 crown cam region on S2: 0.01 mm); MVP2 load path through the O2 pushrod fails at 10 N.m (2500 N on a 4 mm crank).

frozen_exact.protocol: fit Bench(60,160) fast -> wear frozen on Bench(110,360) CB_EXACT=1 (models/cam-unfold-4th.py frozen)

v_note: Independent verifier 2026-10-16 (docs/concepts/verify/cam-unfold-4th.py, model imported unchanged; outputs docs/concepts/verify/cam-unfold-4th/): fit Bench(60,160) fast -> frozen -> Bench(110,360) EXACT, fold margin 5, O20. Reproduces 26.70 (score 90.29) on the farm AND locally (identical digits); near-touch 28.40 (3 poses < 1 mm, min 0.83 mm); overhead >= 140 reach 8/28. Verifier checks written independently of the closed form (per-joint axes from member frames, hub-3 centre, knee pins, the cam law dK = sign(psiA) c(x(q2)) read back from the frames, q2 inside the dowel slot, effective-dyad margin >= 5, K interior angle, finite-difference transmission >= gmin) knock out 0 of 344 taken poses (max axis error 0.02 deg, cam-law error 0.00 deg, min effective margin 5.06, min gain 0.44 vs floor 0.29). Hardware red team (hub 2 crown +5: the follower lever must ride ABOVE a ring fixed to link 1, since the O20 v5 crown is link 2a's own cap; hub K crown +3 for the crank inside its O20 footprint): 26.70, unchanged. Champion 3R on the same bench and protocol: 66.97 (offset-skin-normal-3r verifier; 64.93 in the arm-parked champbig run; 75.94 risley-turret checks). Not refuted; NOT a new leader: ties the pin knee H1 (27.20 same protocol, 0.5 < 1 point) at +14.25 complexity, 7.6 behind minarc BDp. Open buildability items (not in the bench): the crown cam's pressure angle is ~41 deg at the <= 7 mm pitch radius an O20 crown ring allows (1.5 slope, 4 mm crank, 1:1 lever; the claimed 27 deg needs the 12 mm pitch of the O30 flange) - a 2:1 follower lever brings it to ~23 deg; link 1's pin must pass through hub 2's cap to carry the ring, displacing J2's magnet / PCB encoder; the pushrod must climb to crown height at both ends.
